Subject: Important Reminder Regarding Punctuality for Client Meetings

Hi [Employee Name],

I wanted to touch base regarding your recent attendance at client meetings. It is crucial that we maintain a high standard of professionalism, and being punctual is a key part of that. We have noticed a pattern of tardiness recently, and we need to ensure this improves moving forward.

Please make the necessary adjustments to your schedule to ensure you arrive on time for all future engagements. Consistent lateness can impact our reputation and may lead to further disciplinary measures, so I appreciate your immediate attention to this matter.

On a lighter note, while we focus on being on time, it is always nice to take a moment to appreciate the fluffy things in the sky rain comes from.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
